name: instagram_me
description: Which account these calls act as: { user_id, username, name, account_type, profile_picture_url, followers_count, media_count }. The `user_id` is the account's Instagram id. Start here when you are unsure whose grid you are about to post to. `account_type` has to be BUSINESS or MEDIA_CREATOR — a personal account cannot publish or read messages, and nothing else here will work.
